questions: Trace report normalization, validation checkpoints and deterministic acceptance outside worker claims.
Check missing evidence-packet path in the concise prompt and stagnation fingerprints.
decision: Bind validation evidence to exact code, task contract and executed argv; keep deterministic acceptance authoritative and make failure packets available to both production prompt paths.
code_observations: Production runner_contract.worker_prompt calls failure_context without the plan directory, so the inspected path does not include the available evidence-packet pointer.
Worker completion reports, runner validations and resumable validation checkpoints are distinct. Passing report schema checks alone is not product acceptance.
implementation_steps: Pass the correct plan directory through the composed prompt path and explicitly permit only the assigned evidence packet and bounded relevant diagnostic artifacts.
Pin validation receipts to command, source state, resource-map digest and attempt/job identity. Reuse a successful receipt only when the inputs are still current.
Keep failure classification deterministic where evidence is explicit. Record environmental faults and test time limits separately from semantic code failures.
Sanitize diagnostic data before truncation and preserve machine-readable evidence references so a new worker can inspect facts without the whole history.
Add negative tests where a worker claims success but output behavior, a negative case or an integration contract fails. The runner must keep the task incomplete.
Bind check receipts to task contract, executed argv, source inputs and map/toolchain evidence; distinguish historical validity from current applicability.
Add negative tests proving each behavioral criterion fails without its implementation.
Pass the evidence packet through both legacy and composed prompt paths without changing the static prefix.
proposed_acceptance_tests: The composed prompt contains a valid evidence-packet pointer after a failed validation.
A changed source/map/command invalidates a previously successful receipt.
A valid success JSON with failing tests cannot complete the task.
A repeated failure fingerprint is stable under timestamps/PIDs but changes for a genuinely different failure.
A resumed completed worker checkpoint validates without unnecessary model redispatch.
A log from another code digest or substituted command cannot satisfy acceptance.
A forged completed report with no runner validation remains incomplete.
Both prompt builders include only the assigned current evidence packet.
A diagnostic suggestion cannot set failure class or completion state.

alternatives.tradeoff: Lowest verification cost; False completion and unverified tests. Reject

alternatives.title: Run the full suite after every edit
alternatives.tradeoff: Broad checks; High latency and redundant work. Use at integration boundaries

alternatives.title: Scoped deterministic checks plus final regression
alternatives.tradeoff: Traceable quality and bounded cost; Requires precise acceptance mapping. Recommended

alternatives.disposition: Supplement only for inherently qualitative criteria
alternatives.tradeoff: Flexible judgments; Anchoring and unverifiable success. Supplement only for inherently qualitative criteria

cost_model: Run cheap focused checks for fast feedback and full regression at integration milestones. Optimize validated outcome cost, including false-positive acceptance and later repair.
unverified: A narrow unit suite does not prove end-user quality. Real integration/environment coverage must be declared rather than implied.
Neither structural receipt checks nor claimed reviewer metadata prove a real independent model ran. Orchestrator dispatch provenance must be checked outside worker-authored JSON.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated provider invocation, live quota/cost benchmark, independent model review, or Windows runtime test was performed in this research revision.
previous_decision: Make acceptance depend on pinned deterministic validation evidence and ensure the production prompt exposes the allowed evidence packet.
revision_delta: The revision distinguishes historical receipt integrity from current regression validity, adds negative acceptance cases and scopes the known missing evidence-packet argument to the composed production runner.
decision_analysis: A worker report that says completed is a claim, not acceptance. The runner should bind its own test execution to the source revision or scoped content digest, task contract, argv, relevant map generation and toolchain. A stale test log can remain valid historical evidence while failing to demonstrate the current code still passes.

Different tests provide different strength. A parser unit test cannot prove user-visible workflow completion, and a visual snapshot cannot prove keyboard behavior. Map each acceptance case to the exact test boundary and add negative tests that fail before the fix. If a task changes the validation itself, preserve a baseline comparator and independent review of the test change.

The production path composes run_isolated with runner_contract and pattern handling. Fix the failure_context call so its assigned evidence packet is available in every actual prompt path. Put dynamic failure context after stable rules; references point to sanitized bounded evidence rather than embedding full logs or prior transcripts.

Automatic failure classification should prioritize explicit tool/environment evidence, not LLM confidence. A model can suggest a diagnosis but cannot change authoritative failure class, route, acceptance or completed status. Historical self-correction research supports this conservative design, while not implying current models cannot improve with reliable tests.
